Usage: bubo prepare [all|runtime|model] [OPTIONS]

Prepare pinned runtime and model files. The default step is all.
The model step downloads and verifies the files of one model:
the default Flash Next package, or --catalogue-id ID.
The runtime step installs AMD ROCm 10.0.0 for gfx1151 in a shared per-user folder.

Options:
  --output ROOT  Parent folder (default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Bubo)
  --yes          Accept the displayed download plan
  --verify       Force full SHA-256 verification of selected files
  --offline      Use local files only; missing files fail before network
  --resume       Resume tool-owned partial downloads (default)
  --no-resume    Restart partial downloads
  --mtp-model PATH  Copy a hash-matching existing MTP file
  --mmproj PATH     Copy a hash-matching existing vision projector
  --model-set SET   Model files: huihui (default), original or lowmemory
  --catalogue-id ID Model from the catalogue (bubo models list)
  --plan            Model step: show files, sizes, free space and
                    licences, then stop (no download, no write)
  --cache-dir PATH  Runtime archive cache
  --runtime-dir PATH  Runtime destination (default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Bubo\runtime\rocm-10.0.0-gfx1151)
  --help         Print help without writes, network or engine loading

Model layout: ROOT\models\huihui-qwen38-flash-next-ud-q4-k-xl-v1\
  Four main shards; mtp\, mmproj\, twin\, draft_head\ files.
  --model-set original uses ROOT\models\qwen38-flash-next-base-ud-q4-k-xl-v1\

Exit codes: 0 success/help; 2 syntax/schema/header/profile; 3 consent/cancel;
  4 offline/missing pin; 5 transport/TLS; 6 integrity; 7 storage/access;
  8 prepare lock; 9 archive/internal.

Usage: bubo serve [SERVER_OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [OPTIONS]

Start the OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for a specific model modality.

Commands:
  llm       Serve text LLM endpoints (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions) [default]
  video     Serve MiniMax H3 video generation endpoint (/v1/video/generations)
  image     Serve Qwen-Image-2.1 (/v1/images/generations, /v1/images/edits)
  tts       Serve Qwen3-TTS speech synthesis (/v1/audio/speech)
  asr       Serve Qwen3-ASR transcription (/v1/audio/transcriptions)

Server:
  -i, --host <IP>        Bind address (default: 127.0.0.1)
  -p, --port <N>         Port to listen on (default: 8080)
  -j, --sessions <N>     Preallocated GPU request sessions (default: 1)
      --max-connections <N>
                         Maximum simultaneous HTTP connections (default: 16)
      --max-request-bytes <N>
                         Maximum HTTP request body bytes (default: 8388608)
      --api-key <KEY>    Require Bearer authorization for requests; if absent, serve reads the key from BUBO_API_KEY

Logging:
      --log-level <LEVEL>
                         Log verbosity: error, warn, info or debug (default: info)
  -v, --verbose          Shorthand for --log-level=debug

General:
  -h, --help             Print help

Usage: bubo serve llm [OPTIONS] Start the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible text LLM HTTP server. Model: -m, --model GGUF model file or DiffusionGemma checkpoint directory (default: the model that 'bubo prepare' installed) --mmproj Matching BF16 vision file (auto-discovered beside model) --served-model-name Model identifier exposed by the OpenAI API (default: package ID or file stem) -c, --context Context tokens per session (default: 0 = model native context) Sampling Defaults: -n, --max-tokens Default new-token limit (default: -1 = until EOS or context full) -t, --temperature Randomness scale; 0 selects greedy (default: model/thinking preset) --top-k Highest-logit token limit; 0 disables (default: model preset) --top-p
